zones.name: South Wilderness Insertion
zones.description: Player Start at (700, 15) in South-East misty pine ridge; dirt logging road winding from (40, 300) down through western trees with boulder clusters and stealth bushes.

zones.name: East Flank Ridge & Scout Overwatch
zones.description: Elevated wooded trail overlooking main camp perimeter, patrolled by 2x E10 Scouts (60m binocular sightlines) and guarded by Buried Mines M02_T4_01 (610, 210) and M02_T4_02 (645, 275).

zones.name: Outer Fenced Perimeter & Pillbox Line
zones.description: Continuous connected chain-link fence (x: 240..560, y: 250..480) with 4 corner watchtowers ([245, 255], [555, 255], [245, 475], [555, 475]) manned by 4x E12 Sentries, 2 pillboxes at South Gate (400, 250) and West Gate (240, 365), Tripwires M02_T1_01/02, and Directional Mines M02_T3_01/02.

zones.name: Main Militia Encampment & Radio Comms
zones.description: Militia barracks tents, concrete Radio Comms Building ([390, 370] to [415, 395] with rooms R1/R2/R3 and S1 Radio Equipment at (400, 380)), 2 Alarm Panels (M02_ALM_01 at (395, 365), M02_ALM_02 at (310, 350)), Noise Traps M02_T8_01/02, E1 grunts, and Radio Officer M02_E3_01.

zones.name: Inner Command Tent Compound
zones.description: High-security inner fenced enclosure housing Command Tent (prop_tent_command_a) at (450, 490) with Safe & classified documents (O1), patrolled by second Radio Officer M02_E3_02 (S2).

zones.name: North & West Escape Wilderness
zones.description: Forest extraction trail leading to West Extraction Zone at (40, 320) (radius 10.0m).

primary.title: Steal documents from safe in command tent at (450, 490)

extraction.title: Extract at West Forest Extraction Zone (40, 320)

events.description: At elapsed >= 600s, morning mist clears, increasing enemy vision range by +25%.
At elapsed >= 480s, patrol squads P3 and P4 swap sectors in Zone D.
If alert_level == 3 for 45s (and S1 Radio Equipment at (400, 380) is not destroyed), spawns tactical jeep veh_jeep_tactical_a with 4x E1 militia reinforcements at (40.0, 300.0).

silent.name: Silent Route (East Ridge Prone Disarm & East Fence Cut)
silent.description: Insert at (700, 15), creep up Zone B East Ridge (620, 210) using Prone crawl to disarm buried mines, cut East perimeter fence at (560, 310) & disarm M02_T1_01, slip north to (540, 490), enter Command Tent East flap to (450, 490), and exfiltrate west to (40, 320).

technical.name: Technical Route (Radio Comms Sabotage S1 & Inner Gate Hack)
technical.description: Advance from (700, 15) to South-East approach (400, 180), enter Zone D Radio Comms Building via South doorway to (400, 380) to destroy S1 Radio Equipment, exit North doorway to (400, 490), enter Command Tent West doorway to (450, 490), and extract at (40, 320).

loud.name: Loud Route (South Ridge Overwatch, C4 Breach & Direct Assault)
loud.description: Move from (700, 15) to South Ridge overwatch (525, 95), breach South-East perimeter at (450, 240), advance along central compound corridor (450, 420) into Command Tent South doorway at (450, 490), and fight out west to (40, 320).

structures.description: Heavily guarded Command Tent at (450, 490) housing Safe with classified documents (O1).
Barracks Tent #1 housing sleeping Militia Grunt M02_E1_01.

traps.counter: Prone disarm (4.0s) or Binocular earth-decal scan at 5m
